title: done event
description: Final event of a successful backend run (ARCHITECTURE 4.2). The optional fields carry the payload of the command that finished: `path` for `get`, `freed_bytes` for `remove`, and `clipboard_history_contains_code` for `login-finish` (ARCHITECTURE 4.7). `warning` is a stable code for a non-fatal problem (B13: `activation_bytes` when `login-finish` saved the login but could not fetch the account-wide AAX key).
